name: iMessage over SSH
description: Read and search Messages on a reachable Mac from your cloud bots. Connect your own SSH gateway endpoint; no OpenTeam desktop app is required.
installationSteps: Install this package's reader on the Mac signed in to Messages. Enable SSH and grant the remote user access to Messages history.
Run the included gateway on your VM host or another machine that can SSH to that Mac. Keep its dedicated SSH key on that host.
Configure the gateway endpoint and token below, then connect and test imessage_status. The endpoint must be reachable from the OpenTeam server.
The Mac must remain online. This version reads chats and messages; it does not send, modify messages, download attachments, or resolve Contacts names.

setup.title: Connect your iMessage gateway
setup.description: Connect the endpoint that runs SSH on your behalf. Use an internal HTTP address on a trusted private network, or override the MCP URL with your HTTPS endpoint. SSH credentials remain on the gateway host.
steps: Follow connector/SETUP.md in this package to install the restricted Mac reader and host-side gateway.
Enter the gateway host and port, such as host.docker.internal:8799. A Mac IP alone is not a gateway endpoint.
Configure the gateway token using the secret field. For public routing, set the connection's MCP URL to your HTTPS address ending in /mcp.
Run imessage_status in Test tool, then ask a bot to find a conversation. No public listener on the Mac is required.

fields.label: Gateway host and port
fields.helpText: The host running gateway.py, reachable from the OpenTeam server. For HTTPS, override the connection's MCP URL.

fields.label: Gateway token
fields.helpText: The random token from the gateway's private token file. Never enter an SSH private key here.

skills.name: imessage-remote
skills.description: Read and search iMessage or SMS history on a Mac through a configured remote SSH gateway, including connection troubleshooting.
